title: Rename calc_tot to total_price (keep a deprecated alias)
description: In cart.py the function calc_tot(items) is badly named. Rename it to total_price(items) (same behaviour: sum of price*qty for dict items with 'price' and 'qty') and update every caller in the repo. Keep `calc_tot` importable as a thin alias that emits a DeprecationWarning when called and returns the same result. Also make total_price skip items whose qty is 0 or negative.
